title: Frappe ERPNext 14.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 14.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contain a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the CRM module. This flaw arises because notes on Leads and Opportunities are saved without proper HTML sanitization. Authenticated users with the Sales User role can inject malicious scripts that execute in other users' sessions when they view the affected records, potentially allowing actions with the victim's permissions.
